Film 'Satluj' removed from OTT, government forms review panel

The film 'Satluj', which reportedly explores Punjab's history, was removed from the OTT platform Zee5 shortly after its release. The Indian central government has formed a high-level committee to examine the film's content following its takedown. Political leaders and the film's director have commented on the situation, with some suggesting the removal was expected.
